title: The Lord is Faithful Over the Years
verse: Not one of the Lord’s faithful promises to the family of Israel was left unfulfilled; every one was realized.
observation: There is a statement that says, “You can’t see the forest for the trees.” This means you get so obsessed about something specific, you cannot see the overall picture. Many times, when God does something in our lives, we can be so quick to go on to the next thing, we forget to look back and see how far He has brought us. The book of Joshua looks back over all that has happened and remarks that God really did do all He said He would do. Not a SINGLE THING was left undone.
application: Take time to look back and be thankful.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your consistent faithfulness over the years.
